verdict.rationale: Cognee's pricing page states outright that 'Cognee is open source' and can be run locally on your own stack for free, forever. The docs back this with a free, account-free local mode (cognee.start_ui()) and a public Docker image. Missing for 10: the specific license name (e.g. Apache/MIT), a link to the public source repository, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the full source, not just the core engine, is readable under that license.
